annotations.title: Score the move and list what needs a person (free)

description: Reads the app file the owner uploaded (nc_connect with purpose export) and returns a move score from 0 to 100, how ready each page is, a plain-words list of what needs a person, what moves by itself, the names of the secrets to re-enter, and the price of each way to finish the move. Read only for the owner's app: nothing is changed or charged. Works on Bubble® apps. Needs the file uploaded first; the result is kept with the file and deleted with it.

detail.description: summary (default) lists the 10 pages that need the most attention. full lists every page and reusable element.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded (nc_connect with purpose export).

refresh.description: Compute again even if nothing changed. Normally not needed.
